video.decoding_capability: AI Off: 1CH at 32MP, 3CH at 16MP, 6CH at 8MP, 12CH at 4MP (30 fps); AI On: 1CH at 32MP, 2CH at 16MP, 4CH at 8MP, 8CH at 4MP (30 fps)

features: Maximum PoE output per port: 25.5 W
Analytics by Recorder: iMD NVR 8CH, VCA NVR 4CH (10 rules per channel), Face Capture and Recognition 2CH
Analytics by Camera: iMD 8CH, VCA 8CH, Face Picture Comparison Alarm 8CH, LumiSearch+ 8CH (LumiSearch+-enabled camera required), Video Metadata 8CH
License Plate Recognition 8CH (LPR camera required), 2 block lists, 2 allow lists, up to 20,000 plates
Up to 20 face picture libraries (max. 20,000 pictures)
LumiPower long-distance PoE support on PoE ports
Clients: LumiViewer, LumiViewer Mobile App, LumiCloud
notes: Datasheet gives power consumption as < 10 W, HDD not included.
Bandwidth values are for AI Off. With AI On the datasheet gives 200 Mbps incoming and outgoing.
Decoding capability is from the datasheet, which the product page summary matches (1 channel at 32MP or 12 channels at 4MP); the product page decoding property gives 16CH 4MP at 30 fps.
